name: FreshTable
description: Pantry, shopping list, meal plan and the recipes behind them.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.add_pantry: Add a food item to the pantry (food at home), or add to its count if it is already there.
tools.list_pantry: List what is in the pantry. Filter by a food name ("do we have rice"), a category, or use "low" for items running low.
tools.use_pantry: Use up some of a pantry item, or all of it ("we ran out of milk"). With no quantity it is all gone. When none is left it goes on the shopping list.
tools.remove_pantry: Take an item out of the pantry list altogether.
tools.add_shopping: Put an item on the shopping list. An amount and unit are kept if given, and adding the same item again adds to its amount.
tools.list_shopping: List what is still on the shopping list.
tools.check_off_shopping: Tick an item off the shopping list (bought).
tools.remove_shopping: Take an item off the shopping list.
tools.clear_bought_shopping: Clear the ticked-off (bought) items from the shopping list.
tools.add_ingredients_to_shopping: Put a recipe's or a planned meal's ingredients on the shopping list, skipping what is already on it or well stocked in the pantry. Leave recipe out for the whole meal plan.
tools.list_meal_plan: List the meals planned for the week.
tools.add_meal: Plan a meal for a day of the week. A saved recipe of the same name brings its ingredients and steps.
tools.remove_meal: Take a meal off the plan: by day, by name, or both.
tools.plan_week: Plan dinners for the week, favouring the saved recipes. Days that already have a meal are kept unless replace is true; only set replace when the owner said to replace the plan.
tools.add_recipe: Save a recipe: its name, ingredients and instructions.
tools.list_recipes: List the saved recipes with their ingredients. Name one recipe to get its instructions too.
tools.import_recipes: Read recipes from a file the owner sent (text or a photo of a recipe; not PDF) and save them. A text file comes as file_name, mime and text; any other file as file_name, mime and content_b64.

consent: FreshTable keeps your pantry, lists and recipes in its own data folder on this computer. Meal plans, recipe reading and receipt and photo reading use the brain on this computer. It does not use the internet.
